1# Kunlunxin (XPU) override of log2 / log2_. 

2# 

3# log2 was NOT overridden by kunlunxin, so it fell to the generic KernelGen 

4# ops/log2.py, whose kernel body is `tl.log2(x.to(tl.float32))`. On triton-XPU 

5# the tl.log2 intrinsic is mis-lowered and the log2 conversion factor gets 

6# dropped: the kernel computes natural log instead of log2, 

7# log2(2.0) -> 0.693147 (ln 2) instead of 1.0, 

8# i.e. every result is off by exactly ln(2) (res/log(x) == 1.0, verified for 

9# fp32/fp16/bf16 on [1024], [37,91], [2,19,7]; 36/36 test_log2 cases failed 

10# with relative error ~0.307). Special values themselves are right 

11# (0 -> -inf, -0 -> -inf, x<0 -> NaN, +inf -> +inf, NaN -> NaN). 

12# 

13# Fix: compute log2 in terms of the (correct) tl.log intrinsic with an explicit 

14# literal multiplier: 

15# log2(x) = log(x) * (1/ln 2) = log(x) * 1.4426950408889634 

16# (exact same recipe as the sibling log1p.py: tuned CodeGenConfig + 

17# isCloseVectorization=True, which is REQUIRED for the log family -- with 

18# isCloseVectorization=False the vectorized log miscompiles bf16, ~1.6% of 

19# elements off by exactly +ln(2), see log1p.py). 

20# 

21# Both ("log2", log2) and ("log2_", log2_) are already present in the generic 

22# _FULL_CONFIG, so registering these two functions here (and exporting them 

23# from ops/__init__.py) is enough for SpecOpRegistrar to replace the generic 

24# ones -- no _install_register_config_patch entry needed (unlike atanh_). 

25import logging 

26 

27import triton 

28import triton.language as tl 

29from _kunlunxin.utils.codegen_config_utils import CodeGenConfig 

30 

31from ..utils.pointwise_dynamic import pointwise_dynamic 

32 

33logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) 

34 

35# 1 / ln(2) = 1.4426950408889634 (fp32 rel. error ~1.2e-7, far below the test 

36# rtol of 1.3e-6 for fp32 / 1e-3 for fp16/bf16). Inlined literal: triton jit 

37# only allows constexpr globals. 

38 

39config_ = CodeGenConfig( 

40 512, 

41 (65536, 65536, 65536), 

42 32, 

43 True, 

44 prefer_1d_tile=True, 

45 buffer_size_limit=4096, 

46 isCloseVectorization=True, 

47 kunlunAutoGrid=True, 

48 unroll_num=8, 

49) 

50 

51 

52@pointwise_dynamic(promotion_methods=[(0, "COMPLEX_TO_FLOAT")], config=config_) 

53@triton.jit 

54def log2_func(x): 

55 # log2(x) = ln(x) * (1/ln 2), computed in fp32 for precision. 

56 # NOTE: no trailing .to(x.dtype) on purpose -- the output tensor store 

57 # performs the final conversion (sibling exp/arcsinh/atanh follow the 

58 # same pattern). 

59 return tl.log(x.to(tl.float32)) * 1.4426950408889634 

60 

61 

62def log2(A, *, out=None): 

63 logger.debug("GEMS_KUNLUNXIN LOG2") 

64 if out is None: 

65 return log2_func(A) 

66 log2_func(A, out0=out) 

67 return out 

68 

69 

70def log2_(A): 

71 logger.debug("GEMS_KUNLUNXIN LOG2_") 

72 log2_func(A, out0=A) 

73 return A
